title: 第一百六十三章 梦境第一百六十二章 火云记事下
content_zh:
“那妖女之所以没有成功收服红莲业火，就是因为缺少了乾元燃血功！功法不完整！”一个疑惑解决，但更多的疑惑接踵而至，“不过……血魔宗圣女一脉怎么会来一个正道宗门躲藏？还有那口寒潭，秘境就在下面，这么多年了……没有一个人发现？正道宗门居然会传下魔道功法？太奇怪了……”
继续搜索空间戒指，楚天舒果然发现了《乾元燃血功》与《红莲镇狱功》，以及那本双修之法《凤鸾录》。
要练吗？
“不急。在搞清楚这些功法前，最好是不要轻举妄动。”楚天舒心想。
走出结界，楚天舒坐回舱内手中拿着《凤鸾录》仔细阅读。
“这是什么？”沐芸好奇道，“能看看吗？”
她看着那朱红的封面，若有所思，在记忆里深处，以前似乎也见到过此类书籍，不过那时父母总会训斥：“一边去！小孩子看这个干嘛！”
现在她已不是孩童，但反抗感与好奇心驱使着她一睹为快。
楚天舒往里挪了挪，挤出了一个空位。
沐芸迟疑片刻后，坐上了空位，紧挨着楚天舒。
凤目扫过，仅是看了一眼便面红耳赤：“你……你怎么看这种下流的淫书！”
书上男男女女交颈承欢，栩栩如生。种种姿势，让人心生无限遐想。图画旁还写有修炼的心法要诀，一整部的活春宫图，简直就是羞煞女儿郎。
“小声点。”楚天舒道，“她还在睡觉，不想看你可以不看。”
沐芸红着脸快步走开，她一时间词穷了，不知道该怎么反驳楚天舒。修道半百载，男女之事，她并非一窍不通，只不过她没有伴侣，对于阴阳双修之法不多了解罢了。
“那……你也不能给我看这种……淫秽之物。”沐芸气不过，“哪有男子像你一样这么做的？”
男女之事，不算隐秘，到了年纪自然而然就无师自通了。
楚天舒不想和她争论那么多：“不看就别吵。”
沐芸“乖乖”闭上了嘴，她闭目养神，心中默念清心咒，摒弃杂念。可脑海中时不时地闪过男男女女的一幕幕画面……让她心烦意乱。
经过一番心里搏斗后，怀着对修道知识的好奇，沐芸悄悄探出神识，笼罩整本《凤鸾录》
“呃……我……怎睡地上来了？”柳缦悠悠转醒，她看了看身下的软榻。

“困就多睡一会。”楚天舒道。
“不困了。”柳缦道，她揉揉眼睛，坐到楚天舒身旁，“你在看什么？”
“这不是你该看的东西。”楚天舒合上书严肃道。
“哦。”柳缦连忙起身，回到软榻上。
沐芸：……
“手段是有的，通过这种方式将火毒排出身体……”楚天舒转眼间，已翻看了大半页。其中原理他已弄明白。
继续翻页，直至整本书看完。楚天舒揉揉眼睛，他感到乏了。先前与三灵阵师对弈，消耗了他的大量精力，再加上修补传送阵，他已耗尽精力。
困。
“挪腿，我睡一会儿。”楚天舒道。
柳缦赶忙起身，让楚天舒睡下。
叶尘在一旁看着，心想：“有美在手，何不膝枕乎。可惜可惜，这娃不懂得享受……”
似乎是应了叶尘的话，楚天舒躺在软榻上，能感受到飞舟的颠簸震动，有困意，但横竖睡不着。片刻后，楚天舒睁开眼睛，看向柳缦：“过来，坐在这边。”
柳缦乖乖照做，楚天舒将头枕在她腿上，颠簸震动被缓冲过后，几乎无感，可以知道裙底下那饱满修长的玉腿弹性是有多好。
content_en:
"The reason why the demon girl failed to conquer the Red Lotus Karmic Fire was because she lacked the Qianyuan Blood Burning Technique! The technique was incomplete!" One doubt was solved, but more doubts followed, "But...how could the blood demon sect's saintly daughter come to hide in an orthodox sect? There is also the Han Pond, the secret realm is below, and no one has noticed it for so many years? The righteous sect actually passed down the demonic method? It's so strange..."
Continuing to search for space rings, Chu Tianshu found the "Qianyuan Blood Burning Technique" and "Red Lotus Prison Suppressing Technique" as expected, as well as the dual cultivation method "Feng Luan Lu".
Want to practice?
"There's no rush. It's best not to act rashly until you understand these techniques." Chu Tianshu thought to himself.
After walking out of the barrier, Chu Tianshu sat back in the cabin with "Feng Luan Lu" in his hand and read it carefully.
"What is this?" Mu Yun asked curiously, "Can I take a look?"
She looked at the vermilion cover, thoughtfully. Deep in her memory, she seemed to have seen such books before, but her parents would always scold them at that time: "Go away! Why are children reading this!"
Now she was no longer a child, but her sense of defiance and curiosity drove her to take a look.
Chu Tianshu moved inside and squeezed out an empty seat.
After Mu Yun hesitated for a moment, she sat on the empty seat next to Chu Tianshu.
Feng eyes swept over it, and after just one glance, his face turned red: "You...why do you read such a dirty and obscene book!"
In the book, a man and a woman are having sex with each other, lifelike. Various postures make people have endless reverie. Next to the pictures are written the key points of spiritual practice. The whole picture of live erotica is simply embarrassing for the daughter-in-law.
"Keep your voice down." Chu Tianshu said, "She is still sleeping. If you don't want to look at her, you don't have to look at her."
Mu Yun blushed and walked away quickly. She was at a loss for words and didn't know how to refute Chu Tianshu. Having practiced Taoism for half a hundred years, she is not completely ignorant of matters related to men and women, but she has no partner and does not know much about the method of yin and yang cultivation.
"Then...you can't show me such...obscene things." Mu Yun was furious, "How can any man do this like you?"
Things between men and women are not secretive. When you get older, you will naturally become self-taught.
Chu Tianshu didn't want to argue so much with her: "If you don't want to watch, don't argue."
Mu Yun "obediently" shut her mouth. She closed her eyes and rested her mind. She silently recited the Qingxin Mantra in her heart and got rid of distracting thoughts. But scenes of men and women flashed through her mind from time to time... making her upset.
After some inner struggle, with curiosity about the knowledge of monasticism, Mu Yun quietly explored her spiritual consciousness and enveloped the entire "Feng Luan Lu"
"Uh... I... why did I sleep on the floor?" Liu Man woke up leisurely and looked at the soft couch beneath her.
"If you're tired, sleep a little longer." Chu Tianshu said.
"I'm not sleepy anymore." Liu Man said. She rubbed her eyes and sat next to Chu Tianshu, "What are you looking at?"
"This is not something you should read." Chu Tianshu closed the book and said seriously.
"Oh." Liu Man quickly stood up and returned to the soft couch.
Mu Yun:......
"There is a way to expel the fire poison from the body..." Chu Tianshu had already read half of the page in the blink of an eye. He has figured out the principle.
Keep turning the pages until you have read the entire book. Chu Tianshu rubbed his eyes, feeling tired. The previous game with the three spirit formation masters consumed a lot of his energy, and coupled with repairing the teleportation array, he had exhausted all his energy.
Sleepy.
"Move your legs, I'll take a nap." Chu Tianshu said.
Liu Man quickly got up and asked Chu Tianshu to sleep.
Ye Chen watched from the side and thought to himself: "If you have beauty in your hand, why not sleep on your knees with it? It's a pity that this kid doesn't know how to enjoy..."
As if in response to Ye Chen's words, Chu Tianshu lay on the soft couch. He could feel the bumps and vibrations of the flying boat. He felt sleepy, but he couldn't sleep anyway. After a while, Chu Tianshu opened his eyes and looked at Liu Man: "Come here and sit here."
Liu Man obeyed her instructions, and Chu Tianshu rested his head on her lap. After the bumps and vibrations were cushioned,It's almost imperceptible, and you can tell how elastic the plump and slender legs are under the skirt.
